answer.rationale: P99 latency degradation confined to primary region during settlement peak, with a non-revertible security patch in flight. Regional failover is the only option that: (1) preserves the mandatory security patch, (2) leverages proven playbook from memory_b2 (March degradation—latency recovered within minutes via traffic shift), (3) maintains write availability during peak settlement traffic, (4) provides immediate relief while engineering investigates the root cause offline. Circuit breakers risk dropping writes; add_capacity has lead time; read replica routing doesn't help write path latency. Failover is lowest-risk intervention within constraints.
